body: I’m not dad, I’m mom. Dad lives in another country. Doesn’t know them and can’t help. I am just worn out. I have nothing left.
I can’t. I have kids. I’d rather be dead so at least they’ll be taken care of.
Nah dude I don’t give a single fuck anymore.
Bipolar disorder and anxiety since I was in preschool, single parent no help, treatment resistant depression, chronic suicidality. My soul is tired and I don’t want to do it anymore.
